# Setlist Pick 'Em

> Free setlist picks / fantasy setlist game for Phish fans (more bands soon). Predict openers, closers, encore, and a wildcard before each show; compete live as songs are played. Tour Insights (tour setlist statistics, bustouts by tour) refresh every night the band plays live.

## Names

- Setlist Pick 'Em
- Setlist Pick'Em
- Setlist Pickem
- setlistpickem.com

## Not a setlist archive

Sites like Phish.net and setlist.fm are outstanding archives of what was already played. Setlist Pick 'Em is a **live setlist prediction game** (fantasy setlist picks): you lock songs and slots before showtime and score as the night unfolds. Built first for jam bands like Phish; more bands soon.

## How it works

- Lock picks before showtime (predicting setlists, not browsing archives)
- Scoring updates live during the show — at the venue or on couch tour
- Global and private leaderboards
- Personal stats unlock when you play

## Scoring (per slot)

Nights already played keep the ladder that was live that night. The new ladder starts December 30, 2026 (New Year's Run 2026-2027).

- In setlist, wrong slot: 5 pts
- Exact slot: 10 pts
- Wildcard hit: 10 pts before December 30, 2026; 5 pts starting that date
- Encore: 15 pts for any encore song before December 30, 2026. Starting that date, the first encore song is 15 and a later encore song is 10
- Bustout Boost (song gap 30+ shows): +20 pts on top of base

## Tour Insights (tour setlist statistics)

Public aggregates only — never full night setlists. Numbers refresh every night the band plays live.

- Unique songs: distinct titles played this tour (unique songs played this tour).
- Song frequency: how often each title shows up on this tour (most-played / tour setlist stats). Ties break by all-time plays.
- Bustouts: songs that returned after a 30+ show gap (bustouts summer tour 2026; Phish bustout list this tour). Same gap band as Bustout Boost™ on a correct pick.

Deep link — 2026 Summer Tour setlist statistics: https://www.setlistpickem.com/tour-stats/2026-summer-tour

Phish at Madison Square Garden: the songs they play most, what opens the night, the debuts, the long waits between visits, and New Year's Eve. Phish has played Madison Square Garden 96 times over an incredible 32 years, from December 30, 1994 through July 29, 2026. July 29, 2026 was the band’s 96th performance at MSG, capping a 5-show run that transported us back to the 90’s, complete with cut-off tees and vacuum antics. This New Year’s run, Phish returns to the Garden for 4 nights, ending with their 100th performance at the venue on January 2, 2027. https://www.setlistpickem.com/phish-at-msg

2026 Phish tours on one page: shows, different songs, most-played songs, and bustouts. Songs played more than once in a show are counted toward total times played, per phish.net. Our stats count the nights a song was performed separately from the total times it was played. https://www.setlistpickem.com/tour-stats/2026

New Year's Run 2026-2027 at Madison Square Garden: December 30, December 31, January 1, and January 2. January 2, 2027 is the 100th performance at the Garden. The page lists those four shows and links to phish.com. It does not list a night's setlist. Create a NYE pool from that page. https://www.setlistpickem.com/tour-stats/2026-2027-nye-run

Pick the 100th: the public board for January 2, 2027 at Madison Square Garden. Handles, rank, points, and exact slots. No email addresses. https://www.setlistpickem.com/phish-at-msg/100th

Rewind results: how many players locked a past show and how many hit each slot. No setlist. https://www.setlistpickem.com/rewind

Phish IQ: a free daily Phish quiz. Five questions, a new quiz every day, no sign-in. The share card shows a score, not the answers. Questions use public song counts and Madison Square Garden totals. Data courtesy of Phish.net (The Mockingbird Foundation). No setlist. https://www.setlistpickem.com/phish-iq

Hub (Tour Insights / Phish tour setlist statistics): https://www.setlistpickem.com/tour-stats
